trĭentārĭus , a, um, adj. triens, II. B.,
I.of or belonging to a third part: faenus, i. e. a third of one per cent. monthly, or, in our manner, four per cent. a year, Capitol. Anton. P. 2; Lampr. Alex. Sev. 21, 1.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
